questions.text: In this section, you learned to simplify the complex fraction \(\frac{\frac{3}{x+2}}{\frac{x}{{x}^{2}-4}}\) two ways: rewriting it as a division problem or multiplying the numerator and denominator by the LCD. Which method do you prefer? Why?

questions.text: Efraim wants to start simplifying the complex fraction \(\frac{\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}}{\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b}}\) by cancelling the variables from the numerator and denominator, \(\frac{\frac{1}{a}+\frac{1}{b}}{\frac{1}{a}-\frac{1}{b}}.\) Explain what is wrong with Efraim’s plan.
